subject: DI04000241

body.en:
Start with the situation

A casting may have the rough shape of a shaft, but its bearing seat still needs accurate size, roundness and finish.

Definition / principle

Machining removes controlled material from a workpiece to achieve specified geometry, dimensions and surface quality.

Understand why

The tool and work need relative cutting motion; feed exposes fresh material; depth of cut sets the engaged layer.

Application / illustration

Turning a shaft, milling a keyway and drilling a mounting hole are different solutions to different features.

Common mistake / conditions

Machining cannot automatically repair a wrong material, internal defect or insufficient machining allowance.

What does increasing depth alone change?

Engaged cross-section and load/MRR generally increase; cutting velocity is not automatically changed.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Castingમાં shaftનો rough shape મળે,પણ bearing seat માટે accurate size,roundness,finish જોઈએ.

Definition / Principle

Machiningમાં workpieceમાંથી controlled material દૂર કરીને required geometry,dimensions,surface quality મેળવીએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Tool-workની relative cutting motion જોઈએ;feed fresh material આપે;depth of cut engaged layer નક્કી કરે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Shaft turning,keyway milling,mounting-hole drilling જુદા features માટે જુદા solutions છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Wrong material,internal defect કે ઓછી machining allowance machiningથી આપમેળે સુધરતાં નથી.

ફક્ત Depth વધે તો શું બદલાય?

Engaged cross-section,load/MRR સામાન્ય રીતે વધે;cutting velocity આપમેળે બદલાતી નથી.

h.en: 1.1.2 Classify removal processes and machine tools
h.gu: 1.1.2 Removal Processes અને Machine Toolsનું Classification

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify by removal mechanism and by the principal motion/feature produced.

Understand why

Conventional cutting uses a defined edge:turning, milling, drilling, shaping and boring.

Abrasive processes use many small grains:grinding, honing and lapping; grains have irregular cutting geometry.

Non-traditional examples include EDM, electrochemical and laser machining; their removal mechanisms differ from chip cutting.

Lathe:work rotates. Mill/drill:cutter rotates. Shaper:tool reciprocates. Planer:work reciprocates. Grinder:abrasive wheel rotates.

Common mistake / conditions

Select by feature, size, accuracy, material, quantity and economics—not simply by machine availability.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Removal mechanism તથા principal motion/feature પ્રમાણે classify કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Conventional cuttingમાં defined edge વપરાય:turning,milling,drilling,shaping,boring.

Abrasive processesમાં અનેક નાના grains હોય:grinding,honing,lapping;geometry irregular હોય.

Non-traditionalમાં EDM,electrochemical,laser machining આવે;removal mechanism chip cuttingથી જુદું છે.

Latheમાં work rotate થાય.Mill/drillમાં cutter rotate થાય.Shaperમાં tool reciprocate થાય.Planerમાં work reciprocate થાય.Grinderમાં abrasive wheel rotate થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Feature,size,accuracy,material,quantity,economicsથી પસંદ કરો—ફક્ત ઉપલબ્ધ machineથી નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The cutting edge must withstand heat, compressive stress, wear and occasional impact.

Understand why

Hot hardness retains edge hardness at cutting temperature. Wear resistance limits gradual material loss.

Toughness resists chipping under interrupted cuts; very hard material is not necessarily tough.

HSS is tough and convenient for complex/sharpenable tools. Cemented carbides allow higher speeds but need rigid support.

Coated carbides use thin hard coatings to improve wear/heat behaviour; substrate and coating must suit the cut.

Ceramics andCBN suit selected hard/high-temperature work; diamond excels in many non-ferrous/nonmetal applications but is generally unsuitable for hot ferrous cutting.

Is the hardest tool always best?

No. Interrupted cutting may demand greater toughness, edge support and suitable geometry.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Cutting edgeએ heat,compressive stress,wear,ક્યારેક impact સહન કરવાં પડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Hot hardness cutting temperature પર hardness જાળવે.Wear resistance gradual loss ઘટાડે.

Toughness interrupted cutમાં chipping સામે રક્ષણ આપે;વધુ hard એટલે વધુ tough નહિ.

HSS tough છે,complex/resharpenable toolsમાં અનુકૂળ.Cemented carbide વધુ speed લે,પણ rigid support જોઈએ.

Coated carbideમાં thin hard coating wear/heat behaviour સુધારે;substrate,coating cutને અનુરૂપ હોવા જોઈએ.

Ceramics,CBN selected hard/high-temperature workમાં;diamond ઘણા non-ferrous/nonmetalમાં સારું,પણ hot ferrous cuttingમાં સામાન્ય રીતે યોગ્ય નહિ.

સૌથી Hard Tool હંમેશાં Best?

ના.Interrupted cuttingમાં toughness,edge support,suitable geometry વધુ જરૂરી બની શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A single-point tool has one main effective cutting edge with a nose joining the side and end edges.

Understand why

The chip flows over the rake face. The flank faces the newly generated surface.

Back/side rake guide chip flow and influence force, edge strength and heat.

End/side relief provide clearance so the tool does not rub unnecessarily against the work.

End/side cutting-edge angles locate the edges relative to the shank/reference directions.

Nose radius strengthens the tip and affects theoretical finish; too large a radius can increase radial force/chatter.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Single-point toolમાં એક main effective cutting edge હોય;side,end edgesને nose જોડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Chip rake face પરથી વહે.Flank નવી બનેલી surface તરફ રહે.

Back/side rake chip flow દોરે,force,edge strength,heatને અસર કરે.

End/side relief clearance આપે જેથી tool work સાથે બિનજરૂરી rub ન થાય.

End/side cutting-edge angles edgesને shank/reference direction સામે દર્શાવે.

Nose radius tipને મજબૂત કરે,theoretical finishને અસર કરે;અતિ મોટું radius radial force/chatter વધારી શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A tool signature lists geometry in a fixed order; ASA and other reference systems must not be mixed.

Understand why

In the commonASA order:list back rake, side rake, end relief, side relief, end cutting-edge angle, side cutting-edge angle, and nose radius.

Example ASA8–10–6–6–10–15–0.8 means the first six entries are degrees and the last is nose radius0.8mm.

Positive rake generally lowers cutting force but weakens the edge wedge; negative rake strengthens the wedge but can demand more force/rigidity.

The insert relief code and the effective mounted-tool rake are different things:holder orientation also contributes.

Common mistake / conditions

Geometry values here illustrate notation, not a universal grinding recommendation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tool signature fixed orderમાં geometry દર્શાવે;ASA અને અન્ય systems ભેળવવા નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Common ASA orderમાં back rake,side rake,end relief,side relief,end cutting-edge angle,side cutting-edge angle,nose radius લખો.

ASA8–10–6–6–10–15–0.8માં પહેલાં છ entries degrees છે,last nose radius0.8mm છે.

Positive rake સામાન્ય રીતે force ઘટાડે,edge wedge નબળું કરે;negative rake wedge મજબૂત કરે,પણ વધુ force/rigidity માંગે.

Insert relief code અને mounted-tool effective rake જુદાં છે;holder orientation પણ અસર કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ values notation સમજાવે છે,universal grinding recommendation નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Orthogonal cutting has the cutting edge perpendicular to cutting velocity in the ideal model; oblique cutting inclines it.

Understand why

Orthogonal analysis treats flow in a plane; the chip flows approximately normal to the cutting edge.

Oblique cutting permits side flow and three-dimensional force components.

An ideal wide straight edge cutting a thin layer approximates orthogonal cutting; many practical turning/milling engagements are oblique.

Do not confuse orthogonal cutting with a machine axis merely being at90degrees to another axis.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal modelમાં orthogonal cutting edge cutting velocityને perpendicular હોય;obliqueમાં inclined હોય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Orthogonal analysis planeમાં થાય;chip flow લગભગ edgeને normal હોય.

Obliqueમાં side flow,three-dimensional force components આવે.

Wide straight edgeથી thin layerનું ideal cutting orthogonalને નજીક;ઘણા practical turning/milling engagements oblique હોય.

Orthogonal cuttingને ફક્ત બે machine axes90degrees હોય તેની સાથે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Material ahead of the edge plastically deforms and shears into a chip.

Understand why

Primary deformation occurs in a shear zone; tool-chip friction creates secondary deformation and heat.

Continuous chips often occur with ductile material and stable cutting; long sharp ribbons are an entanglement hazard.

Discontinuous chips commonly occur in brittle materials or unstable conditions. Segmented chips show repeated shear localisation.

Built-up edge is work material adhering near the tip; it changes effective geometry and can spoil finish when fragments detach.

Chip form depends jointly on material, speed, feed, rake, friction and chipbreaker—not on material alone.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Edgeની આગળનું material plastically deform થઈ shear થવાથી chip બને.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Primary deformation shear zoneમાં થાય;tool-chip friction secondary deformation,heat બનાવે.

Ductile material,stable cuttingમાં continuous chips મળે;લાંબી sharp ribbons entanglement hazard છે.

Brittle material/unstable conditionsમાં discontinuous chips;segmented chipsમાં repeated shear localisation હોય.

Built-up edge tip પાસે ચોંટેલું work material છે;geometry બદલે,fragment છૂટે તો finish બગાડે.

Chip form material,speed,feed,rake,friction,chipbreaker આ બધાં factors પર આધારિત છે,ફક્ત material પર નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A cutting fluid supports cooling, lubrication and chip removal when suitable for the process.

Understand why

Cooling limits tool/work temperature and thermal distortion. Lubrication reduces interface friction and adhesion.

Flushing clears chips and swarf; corrosion protection preserves machine and work surfaces.

Desirable properties include cooling ability, lubricity, stability, corrosion resistance, low foaming and compatibility with seals/materials.

Neat oils favour lubrication; water-miscible soluble oils/emulsions and synthetic/semisynthetic fluids offer different cooling/lubrication balances.

Fluid concentration, filtration and contamination need maker-guided management; mist/skin exposure and disposal need approved controls.

Common mistake / conditions

Not every process wants flood coolant; thermal shock, material compatibility and tool-maker guidance matter.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

યોગ્ય processમાં cutting fluid cooling,lubrication,chip removalમાં મદદ કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cooling tool/work temperature,thermal distortion ઘટાડે.Lubrication friction,adhesion ઘટાડે.

Flushing chips/swarf દૂર કરે;corrosion protection machine/work surfaces બચાવે.

Cooling ability,lubricity,stability,corrosion resistance,low foaming,seals/material compatibility જરૂરી ગુણ છે.

Neat oil lubricationમાં ઉપયોગી;water-miscible soluble oil/emulsion,synthetic/semisyntheticમાં cooling-lubrication balance જુદું હોય.

Concentration,filtration,contamination maker guidanceથી સંભાળો;mist/skin exposure,disposal માટે approved controls જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

દરેક processમાં flood coolant યોગ્ય નથી;thermal shock,material compatibility,tool-maker guidance જુઓ.

h.en: 1.1.9 Cutting speed, feed and depth of cut
h.gu: 1.1.9 Cutting Speed,Feed અને Depth of Cut

body.en:
Definition / principle

Separate velocity at the cutting edge from advance per cycle and engaged thickness.

Understand why

Cutting speedVc is relative cutting velocity, commonly m/min. For a rotating diameterDmm:Vc=pi DN/1000.

Turning feedf is mm/rev; linear feed rate isfN mm/min. Milling tooth feedfz is mm/tooth; table feedvf=fz z N.

External turning radial depthap=(Dinitial−Dfinal)/2.Diameter reduction is twice radial depth.

MRR is removed volume per unit time; write mm³/min or a consistently converted unit. It is not cutting speed or productivity by itself.

Diameter falls50→46mm:radial depth?

2mm, not4mm.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Edgeની velocity,cycleદીઠ advance અને engaged thicknessને અલગ સમજો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cutting speed Vc relative cutting velocity છે,સામાન્ય રીતે m/min.Rotating diameter Dmm માટે Vc=pi DN/1000.

Turning feed f mm/rev;linear feed fN mm/min.Milling tooth feed fz mm/tooth;table feed vf=fz z N.

External turning radial depth ap=(Dinitial−Dfinal)/2.Diameter reduction radial depthથી બમણું છે.

MRR unit timeમાં removed volume છે;mm³/min કે consistent converted unit લખો.તે cutting speed કે એકલું productivity નથી.

Diameter50→46mm થાય તો Radial Depth?

2mm,4mm નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

D50mm, Vc30m/min, f0.2mm/rev, ap2mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. N=1000×30/(pi×50)=190.986rev/min
  2. At selected N190rev/min:feed rate=.2×190=38mm/min
  3. Approximate MRR=pi×50×190×.2×2=11938.052mm³/min

Common mistake / conditions

Choose an available speed within recommended limits. The pi DNfap formula is a thin-cut/nominal-diameter approximation.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D50mm,Vc30m/min,f0.2mm/rev,ap2mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. N=1000×30/(pi×50)=190.986rev/min
  2. At selected N190rev/min:feed rate=.2×190=38mm/min
  3. Approximate MRR=pi×50×190×.2×2=11938.052mm³/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Recommended limitsમાં available speed પસંદ કરો.pi DNfap thin-cut/nominal-diameter approximation છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Productivity, tool life, finish, power and stability interact.

Understand why

Higher speed can improve some built-up-edge behaviour but usually accelerates temperature-dependent wear beyond the suitable range.

Increasing feed usually raises MRR and theoretical feed marks; increasing depth raises engagement/load.

Actual finish also depends on nose radius, runout, chatter, tool wear and work material—not only feed.

Tool life ends at a stated wear/quality criterion; it is not simply time until catastrophic tool breakage.

Select conservatively from the actual material/tool recommendation, then check machine speed, power, rigidity, holding and surface requirements.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Productivity,tool life,finish,power,stability એકબીજા સાથે જોડાયેલા છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

વધુ speed અમુક built-up-edge behaviour સુધારે,પણ યોગ્ય rangeથી ઉપર temperature-dependent wear વધે.

Feed વધારવાથી MRR,theoretical feed marks સામાન્ય રીતે વધે;depthથી engagement/load વધે.

Actual finish nose radius,runout,chatter,wear,material પર પણ આધારિત છે,ફક્ત feed પર નહિ.

Tool life stated wear/quality criterion સુધી છે;ફક્ત tool તૂટી જાય ત્યાં સુધીનો સમય નહિ.

Actual material/tool recommendationથી પસંદ કરીને speed,power,rigidity,holding,surface requirements તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An indexable insert provides replaceable cutting edges without regrinding the entire tool shank.

Understand why

Shape affects edge strength and accessibility; seat, clamp and holder must match the insert.

In CNMG120408:C=80degree rhombus, N=0degree normal relief, M=tolerance class, G=insert type/hole/chipbreaker form requiring the standard table.

The numerical pairs identify nominal size, thickness and nose radius; 08 commonly denotes0.8mm nose radius in this designation.

Do not read12 as a universal measured edge length12mm; shape-dependent ISO size tables are required.

Typical CNMG120408 catalogue dimensions are inscribed circle12.7mm and thickness about4.76mm; the code12 is not a direct universal length12mm. Exact dimensions depend on the listed standard/product.

Grade/coating and many chipbreaker suffixes are manufacturer-specific additions; the ISO shape code alone does not specify a cutting recommendation.

Common mistake / conditions

Tool signatures describe tool angles; insert codes describe insert geometry/classes. They are different systems.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Indexable insertથી આખો shank regrind કર્યા વગર cutting edge બદલી શકાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shape edge strength,accessibilityને અસર કરે;seat,clamp,holder insert સાથે match થવાં જોઈએ.

CNMG120408માં C=80degree rhombus,N=0degree normal relief,M=tolerance class,G=standard table મુજબ insert type/hole/chipbreaker form.

Numerical pairs nominal size,thickness,nose radius બતાવે;આ designationમાં08 સામાન્ય રીતે0.8mm nose radius છે.

12ને universal measured edge length12mm ન માનો;shape-dependent ISO size table જોઈએ.

Typical CNMG120408 catalogueમાં inscribed circle12.7mm,thickness લગભગ4.76mm હોય;code12 સીધું universal length12mm નથી.Exact dimensions listed standard/product પ્રમાણે તપાસો.

Grade/coating,ઘણા chipbreaker suffixes manufacturer-specific છે;ISO shape code એકલું cutting recommendation નથી.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Tool signature tool angles બતાવે;insert code insert geometry/classes બતાવે.બન્ને જુદાં systems છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Only authorised supervised practice on a suitable guarded machine is acceptable.

Understand why

Know the emergency stop, guards and permitted procedure; inspect the machine and secure the work/tool.

Remove chuck keys and loose setting tools before rotation. Tie hair and remove loose clothing/jewellery.

Use eye protection; avoid gloves near rotating machinery where entanglement is possible.

Stop safely before measuring, adjusting or clearing chips; use suitable chip tools, never bare fingers.

Isolate hazardous energy for maintenance/setup as required; never defeat guards or operate with an insecure workpiece.

Can a glove make touching rotating chips safe?

No. Entanglement can pull the hand in; stop safely and use the approved chip-removal method.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Suitable guarded machine પર authorised supervised practice જ યોગ્ય છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Emergency stop,guards,permitted procedure જાણો;machine તપાસી work/tool secure કરો.

Rotation પહેલાં chuck key,loose tools દૂર કરો.Hair બાંધો,loose clothing/jewellery દૂર કરો.

Eye protection પહેરો;entanglement શક્ય હોય તે rotating machinery પાસે gloves ટાળો.

Measuring,adjusting,chips clearing પહેલાં safely stop કરો;suitable chip tools લો,bare fingers નહિ.

Required maintenance/setupમાં hazardous energy isolate કરો;guards bypass કે insecure workpiece સાથે operation ન કરો.

Glovesથી Rotating Chipsને અડવું Safe?

ના.Entanglement હાથ ખેંચી શકે;safely stop કરીને approved chip-removal method લો.

title.en: 1.2 Use the concepts:selection and dimensional checks

h.en: 1.2.1 Choose a fluid for the cutting problem
h.gu: 1.2.1 Cutting Problem પ્રમાણે Fluid પસંદ કરો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Start with the process, work material, tool and environmental constraints.

Understand why

High-heat grinding commonly demands effective cooling and filtration; the fluid must suit wheel, bond, work and machine.

Low-speed severe contact may emphasise lubricity; high-speed chip removal may emphasise cooling and delivery.

Water-rich fluids can promote corrosion without proper chemistry; neat oils can create mist/fire concerns requiring approved controls.

Fluid choice is not completed by naming soluble oil:document concentration, maintenance, compatibility and approved disposal.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Process,work material,tool,environmental constraintsથી શરૂઆત કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

High-heat grindingમાં effective cooling,filtration જોઈએ;fluid wheel,bond,work,machineને અનુરૂપ હોય.

Low-speed severe contactમાં lubricity;high-speed chip removalમાં cooling,delivery મહત્વનાં બને.

Proper chemistry વગર water-rich fluid corrosion કરે;neat oilમાં mist/fire concerns માટે approved controls જોઈએ.

ફક્ત soluble oil નામથી choice પૂરી નથી;concentration,maintenance,compatibility,approved disposal નોંધો.

h.en: 1.2.2 Do MRR units agree across processes?
h.gu: 1.2.2 જુદા Processesમાં MRRના Units મળે છે?

body.en:
Given and model

Three separate given cases:turning Vc30m/min, f.2mm/rev, ap2mm; milling width20mm, depth2mm, vf100mm/min; drilling D10mm, f.1mm/rev, N500.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Turning approximation:1000Vc f ap=1000×30×.2×2=12000mm³/min
  2. Milling:20×2×100=4000mm³/min
  3. Drilling:(pi×10²/4)×.1×500=3926.991mm³/min

Common mistake / conditions

Do not compare these as proof one process is universally faster:the features, engagement and required finish differ.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

ત્રણ અલગ given cases:turning Vc30m/min,f.2mm/rev,ap2mm;milling width20mm,depth2mm,vf100mm/min;drilling D10mm,f.1mm/rev,N500.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Turning approximation:1000Vc f ap=1000×30×.2×2=12000mm³/min
  2. Milling:20×2×100=4000mm³/min
  3. Drilling:(pi×10²/4)×.1×500=3926.991mm³/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

h.en: 1.2.3 Select tool material with a reason
h.gu: 1.2.3 કારણ સાથે Tool Material પસંદ કરો

body.en:
Definition / principle

A defensible answer connects the material properties to the cutting duty.

Understand why

For a complex resharpenable form tool at moderate speed, HSS may be convenient because of toughness and grindability.

For repetitive rigid turning, an appropriate carbide grade/insert may offer higher productivity and replaceable edges.

For interrupted engagement, check edge toughness and support before choosing a brittle high-hot-hardness material.

State limitations:coating, chipbreaker, holder, machine and work condition can overturn a simplistic material-only choice.

Is a coolant label enough for selection?

No. Check duty, compatibility, concentration, maintenance and exposure controls.

Are insert size numbers direct dimensions in every shape?

No. Use the shape-dependent designation table.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Defensible answer material propertiesને cutting duty સાથે જોડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Moderate speedના complex resharpenable form toolમાં HSS toughness,grindabilityથી અનુકૂળ.

Repetitive rigid turningમાં suitable carbide grade/insertથી productivity,replaceable edgesનો લાભ.

Interrupted engagementમાં brittle high-hot-hardness material પહેલાં toughness,support તપાસો.

Limitations લખો:coating,chipbreaker,holder,machine,work conditionથી simple material-only choice ખોટી પડી શકે.

Coolantનું નામ Selection માટે પૂરતું?

ના.Duty,compatibility,concentration,maintenance,exposure controls તપાસો.

દરેક Shapeમાં Insert Size Numbers સીધી Dimensions છે?

ના.Shape-dependent designation table લો.
